text:
laura-cs: Heads up 1: DeltaCore dedicated bring-up tomorrow. Need final owners for: quota profile, autoscale tune, warmup script, and renewal-risk note for AM. Window proposed 10:00-12:30 PT. Who's free for 10-12?

rick-ops: I can take 10-12. Will handle load generation and infra knobs (slot rdp-42). I'll run a two-phase test: prefix prime then ramp to steady.

jenn-se: Need the exact load curve. DeltaCore expects chat-heavy traffic (avg tokens ~45, many short turns). Proposal: steady at 65% reserved, 2x microbursts (60s) every 15m during first 90m, then one big burst 4x for 5m at the end for cutover sim.

marco-ml: Model: llama-inf-7b-4bit, KV-enabled, per-request max_tokens 256. Target SLOs: p50 < 110ms, p95 < 320ms, p99 < 700ms. If p99 > 1s for 2 windows, we trigger fallback plan.

eska-rl: I'll own priming: generating prefix set from their real prompts and seeding cache. Script: scripts/delta/prime.sh --src s3://delta/raw-prompts.json --warm-count 800

laura-cs: Also need to capture CS artifacts: quick renewal-risk rubric (green/yellow/red), sample fail cases for the enablement deck, and billing spike watch. Nina can take the risk rubric + customer-facing notes.

nina-cs: On it. Draft rubric: green = meet SLOs + <1% error, yellow = SLO misses or 1-3% errors or billing delta >20%, red = >3% errors or sustained p95 misses >30% of windows. Will attach to post-run summary.

loadbot: Run window booked: deltacore-dedicated - 2025-03-10T17:00:00Z to 2025-03-10T19:30:00Z. Owner: rick-ops. Logs -> s3://redwood-load/deltacore/2025-03-10/ (auto-upload).

rick-ops: Load command (stormrunner):

```
# stormrunner replayer
./stormrunner \
  --account deltacore \
  --pool rdp-42 \
  --model llama-inf-7b-4bit \
  --steady-qps 95 \
  --microburst-qps 190 --microburst-duration 60 --microburst-interval 900 \
  --endburst-qps 380 --endburst-duration 300 \
  --tokens-per-request 45 \
  --out s3://redwood-load/deltacore/2025-03-10/ \
  --log-level info
```

jenn-se: Autoscale policy suggestion: min_pods=3, target_util=0.7, max_pods=18, scale_cooldown=150s. Add a transient headroom +10% during bursts to avoid token throttles.

marco-ml: Fallback flow: if p95 > 600ms for 10m, try switching to llama-inf-7b-q2 (non-KV) for up to 20m while we investigate; if errors spike (>1%), fall back to 3b-model with annotated customer notice. We'll add an automatic note to the runbook.

eska-rl: Priming checklist: 1) collect top 500 prefixes (done), 2) run prime scripts (will run 30m before start), 3) verify cache hit ratio > 60% during warmup.

laura-cs: Can we add an enablement demo immediately after the run (15-20min) to show warmup benefits? Short deck + live replay. Nina, coordinate with DeltaCore PM for 20:00 their local time.

nina-cs: I'll ping their PM and propose 20:15 PST. Also prepping a 1-slide renewal risk summary for AM.

loadbot: Pre-checks passed: IAM write ok, replayer binary checksum verified, KMS key deltacore-kms status OK.

rick-ops: Small infra note: pool has 8 GPUs (A100), reserved cap = 720 token/sec baseline. We're setting token_cap_per_account=250000/min to avoid runaway billing. Verify billing alert hooks.

jenn-se: Observability hooks: histogram per-token latency, KV hit rate, per-instance CPU/GPU %, request queue depth, token throttles/min, billing delta. Create dashboard tab and link here.

marco-ml: We'll attach an eval set: 30 production-sampled prompts + 10 stress prompts. Post-run we'll compute quality delta (BLEU-ish + human spot checks). Nina will collect customer feedback form.

laura-cs: Owner map: rick = run & infra, eska = priming, jenn = autoscale/SLO guardrails, marco = fallback & eval design, nina = renewal & customer comms. I'll send a short runnote to DeltaCore with timeline and expected customer-visible effects.

loadbot: Run started: 2025-03-10T17:00:00Z. Live logs available.

rick-ops: Warmup in progress. Cache hit 0.0% -> 68% after prefix primer. Noting a small spike in p95 at minute 12 of warmup (420ms) - watching.

eska-rl: Confirmed primer complete. KV hit ratio now steady ~70%.

jenn-se: p95 dipped back under 320ms. No token-throttle alarms. LGTM so far.

laura-cs: Great. Nina, prep the post-run feedback form and I'll queue the enablement demo invite once the run finishes.

nina-cs: Form link ready: https://forms.gle/delta-run-eval-2025 - will send to PM 30m after run end.

marco-ml: Quick note for retro: collect any long-tail latency traces and correlate with instance swaps and cache misses. Also check quant artifacts after KV fallback (if triggered).

rick-ops: Running final big burst now. Monitoring p99 closely.

loadbot: Run completed: 2025-03-10T19:28:00Z. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-load/deltacore/2025-03-10/artifacts.tar.gz

laura-cs: Thanks team 60; we'll reconvene in 45m for a short retro and renewal-readout. Nina will post the risk summary in this thread.
